75667-scots-proverbs-ancient-and-modern-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. A friend in court is worth a penny in purse. A friend in need’s a friend indeed. Aft counting keeps friends lang thegither. After a storm comes a ca’m. A fou man and a hungry horse ay mak haste hame. A fou purse never lacks friends. A rough bane maks a fou wame. A fou wame maks a stiff back.

The 40m radiotelescope at Yebes Observator
arxiv-2112-01130.creator: J. Cernicharo, M. Agúndez, C. Cabezas, B. Tercero, N. Marcelino, R. Fuentetaja JR. Pardo, P. deVicente
arxiv-2112-01130.description: Abstract We report on the detection, for the first time in space, of the radical HCCCO and of pentacarbon monoxide, C 5 O. The derived column densities are (1.6 ± \pm 0.2) × \times 10 11 cm -2 and (1.5 ± \pm 0.2) × \times 10 10 cm -2 , respectively.

arxiv-2206-12079.title: On codimension one holomorphic distributions on compact toric orbifolds
arxiv-2206-12079.creator: Miguel Rodríguez Peña
arxiv-2206-12079.description: Abstract . The number of singularities, counted with multiplicity, of a generic codimension one holomorphic distribution on a compact toric orbifold is determined. As a consequence, we provide a classification for regular distributions on rational normal scrolls and weighted projective spaces.

arxiv-2208-03596.title: Origin of the low energy resonance in the double photoionization of pyrene and coronene, and its absence in the double photoionization of corannulene
arxiv-2208-03596.creator: Ralf Wehlitz, David L. Huber
arxiv-2208-03596.description: Abstract The low energy resonance in the double photoionization of the aromatic hydrocarbons pyrene (C 16 H 10 ) and coronene (C 24 H 12 ) is investigated theoretically using an approach based on the one-dimension Hubbard model for π \pi -conjugated systems with nearest-neighbor interactions.

arxiv-2307-04058.title: Further results on the real cubic truncated moment problem
arxiv-2307-04058.creator: Abdelaziz El Boukili, Amar Rhazi, Bouazza El Wahbi
arxiv-2307-04058.description: Abstract . In this paper, we devote our interest to solving the real cubic truncated moment problem. We provide some results that allow to get a complete solution via a minimal representing measure. Some numerical examples are also presented to emphasize the simplicity of our approach. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary:44A60; Secondary: 47A57, 13B40 1.

arxiv-2411-00874.title: VecCity : A Taxonomy-guided Library for Map Entity Representation Learning [Experiment, Analysis & Benchmark]
arxiv-2411-00874.creator: Wentao Zhang 1 , Jingyuan Wang 1 , Yifan Yang 1 , Leong Hou U 2
arxiv-2411-00874.description: Abstract . Electronic maps consist of diverse entities, such as points of interest (POIs), road segments, and land parcels, playing a vital role in applications like ITS and LBS. Map entity representation learning (MapRL) generates versatile and reusable data representations, providing essential tools for efficiently managing and utilizing map entity data.

britannica-1911-train.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-train.description: Article 'Train' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 27), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. trahinare, to drag, draw, Lat. trail, trace, ultimately from the same source), a general term applied to that which is drawn or trailed behind or after anything else, the hind part or rear of anything. It is thus used of the portion of a skirt, robe or cloak which is lengthened behind so that when allowed to fall it trails along the ground.

pmc-10546099.creator: Sabrina Kastaun, Alina Herrmann, Beate S Müller, Stephanie Klosterhalfen, Barbara Hoffmann, Stefan Wilm, Daniel Kotz
pmc-10546099.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveClimate change increases the frequency, intensity and length of heatwaves, which puts a particular strain on the health of vulnerable population groups. pmc-11369459.title: On the partial impact of uncertainties on the nexus between macroeconomic fundamentals in West Africa
pmc-11369459.creator: Bernice Nkrumah-Boadu, George Tweneboah, Siaw Frimpong
pmc-11369459.description: We investigate the degree of interconnectedness between stock returns and exchange rate returns, and the influence of some selected global uncertainty indices on such a relationship within a time-frequency domain in West Africa through the bi and partial wavelet approaches. The analysis was based on monthly observations from February 2013 to June 2023.

pmc-11439833.title: Balloon-expandable covered stenting of a large right hepatic artery aneurysm
pmc-11439833.creator: Baqir J. Kedwai, Matthew Byrne, Joshua T. Geiger, Sam Najjar, Michael C. Stoner, Doran S. Mix
pmc-11439833.description: Hepatic artery aneurysms (HAAs) are rare visceral aneurysms with a high rupture rate. We report the case of an 88-year-old man with a 4.2-cm right HAA treated with covered stenting. Balloon-expandable covered stents effectively excluded the HAA with excellent proximal and distal seals.

pmc-11654683.title: Future spinal reflex is embedded in primary motor cortex output
pmc-11654683.creator: Tatsuya Umeda, Osamu Yokoyama, Michiaki Suzuki, Miki Kaneshige, Tadashi Isa, Yukio Nishimura
pmc-11654683.description: Mammals can execute intended limb movements despite the fact that spinal reflexes involuntarily modulate muscle activity. To generate appropriate muscle activity, the cortical descending motor output must coordinate with spinal reflexes, yet the underlying neural mechanism remains unclear. We simultaneously recorded activities in motor-related cortical areas, afferent neurons, and forelimb muscles of monkeys performing reaching movements.

pmc-12581870.title: Dupilumab Initiation for Surgically Refractory Chronic Rhinosinusitis With Nasal Polyps Is Associated With Differential Expression of CLC and Activation of Eicosanoid Pathways
pmc-12581870.creator: Christina Dorismond, Rory J Lubner, Daniel H Lofgren, Chandler J Rygalski, Ping Li, Katherine N Cahill, Suman R Das, Mason R Krysinski, Rakesh K Chandra, Justin H Turner, Naweed I Chowdhury
pmc-12581870.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Key Points An untargeted transcriptomic analysis provided exploratory insight into key genes and pathways that can be used to help identify patients at risk for surgically refractory chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP). The Charcot–Leyden crystal gene, periostin and osteopontin‐associated pathways, eicosanoid synthesis pathway, and prostaglandin/leukotriene metabolism pathway, among others, are associated with dupilumab prescription for surgically refractory chronic rhinosinusitis and may support early stratification of disease severity in CRSwNP patients.

pmc-13021885.title: Loneliness in adolescents and youth with bipolar disorder: a scoping review
pmc-13021885.creator: Aroldo Dargél, Tanya Tanya, Caitlin Morris, Risa Shorr, Kathleen Pajer
pmc-13021885.description: IntroductionBipolar disorder (BD) commonly emerges in adolescence, a period marked by heightened mood lability and shifting social roles that may amplify interpersonal stressors and functional risk. Loneliness and social isolation are transdiagnostic, developmentally salient constructs associated with psychiatric morbidity and physiological dysregulation, yet their relevance to youth BD has not been comprehensively summarized.

pmc-13034270.title: Machine learning models to detect opioid misuse in emergency department patients at triage
pmc-13034270.creator: Chirag Chhablani, Usman Shahid, Natalie Parde, Sami Muslmani, Huiyi Hu, Dillon Thorpe, Majid Afshar, Niranjan Karnik, Neeraj Chhabra
pmc-13034270.description: Objective:Emergency department (ED) encounters represent valuable opportunities to initiate evidence-based treatments for patients with opioid misuse, but few receive such care. Universal manual screening has been proposed to improve patient identification but is uncommon due to its time and resource-intensive nature.

pmc-13249799.title: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase 1B‐Mediated Granulosa Cell Insulin Resistance Links Metabolic Stress to Aging‐Relevant Ovarian Dysfunction and Is Reversed by Gengnianchun
pmc-13249799.creator: Yanqiu Rao, Ting Xu, Yan Ding, Jun Li, Lingyun Gao, Yun Wang, Wenjun Wang
pmc-13249799.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Metabolic disorders, particularly insulin resistance, are increasingly recognized as accelerators of female reproductive decline. However, the molecular mechanisms by which peripheral metabolic stress translates into impaired ovarian reserve remain incompletely understood. Here, we propose that protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B (PTP1B), a negative regulator of insulin signaling, serves as a molecular bridge linking systemic insulin resistance to aging‐relevant ovarian dysfunction and can be pharmacologically targeted.

pmc-13253198.title: Dual-functional catalytic photothermal immunological agent for ferroptosis induction and cGAS-STING pathway activation: Enhancing tumor immunotherapy and generating robust immune memory
pmc-13253198.creator: Haitao Yuan, Xiaoxian Wang, Yun Meng Bai, Jingbo Ma, Wenzhe Chen, Junhui Chen, Mengyun Hou, Zhijie Li, Ying Long, Jigang Wang
pmc-13253198.description: The resistance to apoptosis and immune evasion of tumor cells significantly increase the risk of cancer treatment failure. Ferroptosis has emerged as a new strategy to address apoptosis resistance in tumor therapy. However, traditional ferroptosis inducers often lead to drug resistance due to the compensatory mechanism of GPX4, while the synergistic effect of photothermal-immunotherapy can circumvent this limitation.

uslaw-usc-t22-s285m.title: 22 U.S.C. § 285m — Withdrawal rights covering United States Special Resources
uslaw-usc-t22-s285m.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s285m.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 7 (International Bureaus, Congresses, Etc.); Subchapter XIV (Asian Development Bank). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The United States shall have the right to withdraw all or part of the United States Special Resources and any accrued resources derived therefrom under the procedures provided for in section 8.03 of the Special Funds Rules.

uslaw-usc-t26-s2037.title: 26 U.S.C. § 2037 — Transfers taking effect at death
uslaw-usc-t26-s2037.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s2037.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 11 (Estate Tax); Subchapter A (Estates Of Citizens Or Residents); Part III (Gross Estate). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) General rule The value of the gross estate shall include the value of all property to the extent of any interest therein of which the decedent has at any time after September 7.
